fill_design: ANIMATION-AWARE (2026-06-21): windows kept <=~23s by splitting the 3 longest scenes -> 24 scenes. STATIC scenes use BOOMERANG, so each still is composed DEEP + ATMOSPHERE-DOMINANT (multiple gentle REVERSIBLE motions: flame, smoke, dust motes, drifting cloud, faint cloth, breathing light) with a LOCKED / imperceptible camera, so a forward+reverse loop reads as a living painting, never a zoom yo-yo. The 3 DIRECTIONAL scenes (13 convergence-drift, 17 crane-down cross->soldiers, 21 nations-streaming) have a clear ONE-WAY vector + 2 continuation clips each so they flow forward and never freeze on a cloned frame.
style_base: Baroque oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro, Caravaggio and Rembrandt lighting, deep shadow and warm golden light, reverent sacred art, muted earth tones, fine visible brushwork
rule: the device is the SAME song a thousand years apart: David's scroll (OT) and the cross (NT) keep echoing; every quote's visual matches its narration cue; the cut CLOSES on the risen Christ (hero). Cross scenes are ROBED with pierced hands shown (veo NSFW workaround). All scrolls carry illegible marks, never legible text.

scenes.title: The ninth hour, the cry
scenes.subject_block: a single seamless full-bleed Baroque oil painting, hard Caravaggio chiaroscuro: a robed figure seen close and intimate against a vast black thunderous noon sky, his head tipped back as he cries out with his last strength, a dark-haired bearded man in his early thirties, robed at the waist (NOT bare-chested), one shaft of cold storm-light breaking across his anguished upturned face, the ninth hour, dark land far below, reverent and restrained NOT graphic; one continuous image, no frame, no panels, no border, no text
scenes.atmos: storm clouds rolling slowly, the shaft of light pulsing faintly, hair and cloth stirring, dust adrift

scenes.title: A thousand years before, David's scroll
scenes.subject_block: a single seamless full-bleed Baroque oil painting, hard chiaroscuro, DEEP layered composition: in the warm foreground an unrolled parchment scroll covered in faint illegible ancient marks, a reed pen and a clay ink pot, a low guttering oil lamp; in the midground an aged Israelite king, a silver-bearded man with a simple bronze circlet and rich plain robes, bent in thought over the page; behind him a vast shadowed stone chamber receding into darkness with a thin hanging curtain; the weight of writing words he does not yet understand; one continuous image, no frame, no panels, no border, no modern text
